runbooks.title: Intermittent 5xx with database errors
runbooks.content: Possible causes: connection pool too small for the traffic, long-running transactions holding connections, database failover, network problems between the service and the database. Check pool metrics, recent configuration changes and database health.

runbooks.title: General HTTP 5xx investigation checklist
runbooks.content: 1. Find the first error in the logs and note the time. 2. Check recent deploys of the affected service near that time. 3. Check dependencies (database, payment gateway, cache). 4. Compare error rate before and after the change.

runbooks.title: Rotating the CDN signing key
runbooks.content: Steps to rotate the CDN signing key every quarter: generate a new key, publish it, wait for propagation, retire the old key.

ground_truth.root_cause: Deploy 3.8.0 reduced the database connection pool (spring.datasource.hikari.maximumPoolSize) from 40 to 4, so the pool is exhausted under normal load
